base.description: ref to resolve .ai-sdlc.yaml from — trusted base, never the PR head

diff_max_bytes.description: byte cap on the PR diff fed to the dependency audit

enabled.description: security.enabled override — 'true'|'false'; empty = resolved contract; overrides clamp strictest-wins (tighten only)

ledger_head.description: upstream run-ledger chain head — seeds this stage entry prev; empty = recover the ai-sdlc:ledger-head marker on the PR (issue #196)

max_vuln_lookups.description: cap on OSV vuln-detail lookups for severity/fix enrichment

min_severity.description: security.min_severity override — low|medium|high|critical; empty = resolved contract

org_config.description: org baseline contract ref owner/repo[/path][@ref] — security.* floors per spec/org-policy.md; empty = repo contract + defaults

runtime_ref.description: ref of os-santiago/ai-sdlc to fetch trusted scripts (security-gate.js, dep-update.js, tools/gitleaks.sh) from — pin to the same ref as this workflow

scan_scope.description: diff = PR commit range (per-PR runs); tree = full history (scheduled sweeps)

severity_matrix.description: security.severity_matrix override — inline JSON {"pr:risk-high":"blocking",...}; empty = resolved contract

ledger_head.description: sealed run-ledger chain head for this gate run (issue #196)

security_gate_outcome.description: strictest applied gate outcome — report-only | blocking-if-fix-available | blocking

AI_SDLC_APP_ID.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App id — mints the per-run installation token used for all gh auth + the PR-head checkout (fail-closed when unset; issue #26)

AI_SDLC_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: ai-sdlc GitHub App private key (PEM) — pairs with AI_SDLC_APP_ID

AI_SDLC_LEDGER_KEY.description: run-ledger signing key (PEM; Ed25519/RSA) — seals stage evidence; absent = unsigned seal (issue #196)
